versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the company-enrichment skill for batch firmographic enrichment via LinkedIn.
- Supports input using company names, domains, or LinkedIn URLs; outputs key data: industry, employee count, headquarters, website, and founding year.
- Free API key available with no signup required; trials limited to 200 credits/IP/day.
- Offers dual setup paths: via MCP endpoint or npm SDK/CLI.
- Batch-friendly design with explicit credit usage reporting and error handling guidance.
- Includes guidance to maximize credit efficiency and handle identifier varieties (URL, slug, domain).
